faq: ClassroomIO is an intelligent customer education platform that helps SaaS companies use education to grow their business. You create courses, deliver them in a branded academy and track how learners progress.

The free plan covers 20 students. The Early Adopter plan is $35 a month and covers up to 10,000 students, with your own domain, branding, certificates, unlimited collaborators, the API and webhooks. Enterprise is priced by quote and includes SSO.
Can I use my own domain and branding?
Yes. Your domain, logo and colors come with the $35 plan, so they are not add-ons.
How does the AI feature work in ClassroomIO?
AI helps draft outlines and lessons, and your team reviews and edits them before anything is published. MCP is available on every plan, so compatible AI assistants can work with your courses.
Can ClassroomIO connect to the tools I already use?
Yes. SCORM, Zapier, webhooks and the public API let you move courses and learner data between ClassroomIO and your other tools. There are no native Salesforce or Gainsight connectors.
Can I run ClassroomIO on my own servers?
Yes. There is a self-hosting guide and the code is open source. Some Enterprise features, such as SSO, need a licence key when you self-host. The prices on this page are for the hosted plans.
Can I move my courses from another platform?
Yes. ClassroomIO supports SCORM, so you can migrate your courses from previous LMS platforms and import them into ClassroomIO.
Is ClassroomIO a full replacement for my current platform?
Yes. ClassroomIO is built to replace most course platforms for customer education.
